question: The single most effective pharmacological component of Active Management of the Third Stage of Labour (AMTSL) for preventing PPH is:

answers.text: Ergometrine 0.5 mg IM immediately after delivery of the anterior shoulder

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Ergometrine is NOT first-line and is contraindicated in hypertension and pre-eclampsia. Oxytocin is preferred. Ergometrine also has a delayed onset compared to oxytocin.

answers.text: Oxytocin 10 IU IM within 1 minute of delivery of the baby

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. Oxytocin 10 IU IM (or IV infusion) within 1 minute of delivery is the WHO-recommended first-line uterotonic for AMTSL. It is effective, safe in all patients (including hypertensives), and has a rapid onset.

answers.text: Misoprostol 600 mcg sublingual administered at the start of the second stage

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Misoprostol is recommended only when oxytocin is unavailable (e.g., home deliveries, resource-limited settings). It is not superior to oxytocin and has more side effects.

answers.text: Carboprost 250 mcg IM repeated every 15 minutes up to 8 doses as prophylaxis

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Carboprost (15-methyl PGF2α) is a TREATMENT agent for established atonic PPH, not a prophylactic AMTSL agent. It is also contraindicated in asthma.

overallFeedback.feedback: The correct AMTSL agent is oxytocin 10 IU IM. Remember: ergometrine is contraindicated in hypertension; carboprost is reserved for treatment, not prophylaxis; misoprostol is a fallback only.
Well done. Oxytocin 10 IU IM within 1 minute of birth is the cornerstone of AMTSL and the single most impactful PPH prevention measure.
